verdict.rationale: RingCentral documents its own AI that takes on specific tasks: an AI Receptionist that answers and routes calls, and an 'Agentic Voice AI platform' that automates and assists customer interactions. That is narrow, task-specific delegation, not a general assistant users hand arbitrary tasks to. The MCP servers and the ChatGPT/Claude connectors are external-LLM integrations, so they earn no credit here. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-app assistant users can delegate arbitrary tasks to, documentation of how users instruct or delegate to it, and any hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: AI Receptionist Answer and route calls on any phone system.
Agentic Voice AI platform to automate, assist, and analyze customer interactions end-to-end.
